# peakst8 product notes

> Product notes for peakst8 features: who each feature is for, the screens and the timeline to go live.

## peakst8 Embed

> peakst8 Embed lets run clubs and fitness communities sell events on their own website. Event pages are server-rendered on the club's domain with Event and FAQ schema, so they rank on Google and get cited by AI answer engines. peakst8 runs checkout, payments, refunds and check-in.

- [Product note](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/embed/): ICP and pilots, the problem, Cubbon Classic 10K case study, launch-to-scale path, SEO and AEO requirements, architecture, V1 scope, timeline, FAQ, open questions
- [Prototype](https://peakst8-basecamp.github.io/product-notes/embed/prototype/): clickable V1 screens (admin A1, organiser O1–O7, attendee E1–E6, club registration C1–C3) with states and build notes
